description: Delhi's air quality remains poor, with several monitoring stations recording alarming AQI levels and significant pollution concerns. The Commission for Air Quality Management is assessing the pollution control measures of Delhi and neighboring states.
title: Delhi wakes up to 'poor' air, AQI at 249

description: De Villiers, who played in the Cape Town Test and scored 64 in the first innings and 63 in the second, has now spoken about the Sandpapergate controversy and the recent claims made by former Australia players Usman Khawaja and Cameron Bancroft.

author: TNN
description: In Bhopal’s Eintkhedi area, a 37-year-old woman named Rukhsana allegedly poisoned her two children and herself. After a dispute with her husband over family matters, Rukhsana brought the children home from school early. She fed them and allegedly dissolved celphos, giving it to the children before consuming it herself. Neighbors heard the children screaming and found the family foaming at the mouth.
title: ‘Have no flour’: Woman poisons 2 kids, dies by suicide

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: In 2011, Vinita Somani's life took a turn when she was diagnosed with breast cancer, igniting her love for cooking. She launched a culinary venture that empowered around 200 women towards financial independence. Following a second diagnosis, she dedicated herself to cancer awareness and patient support, including founding Aapbeeti, a platform for sharing personal battles. Vinita’s story exemplifies resilience and the strength found in community.
title: Jaipur cancer survivor turns chemo cooking into jobs for 200 women

description: India A suffered a 48-run loss to Pakistan A in the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars tournament. Their semi-final hopes depend on the outcome of their upcoming match against the United Arab Emirates. A win against UAE will secure India A's qualification for the next round. The team is competing closely with Nepal for a semi-final spot.
title: Lost to PAK, now what? How IND A can reach Asia Cup Rising Stars semi-finals

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Canadian judge has cancelled a C$4.26 million damages order against a buyer who failed to complete an C$18 million home purchase. The property was later sold for C$14.3 million. The buyer challenged the original judgment, disputing the contract conditions and the compensation claimed by the seller. Although he waited more than three years to approach the court, the judge allowed him to defend the case.
title: Canadian homebuyer backs out of C$18m deal; court revives C$4.26m damages award

description: Alexandr Wang has underscored a pivotal year for humanity as we navigate the realms of superintelligence and artificial intelligence. He pointed out the groundbreaking developments in AI, particularly the evidence surrounding the Riemann Hypothesis. As AI evolves, concerns about maintaining human oversight grow, emphasizing the need for deliberate and responsible AI progression. Wang stresses that establishing safety and alignment measures is paramount for our technological future.
title: Meta AI chief warns: Superintelligence is coming, danger depends on humans

description: Donna Kelce and Andrea Swift found common ground through their children's relationship. Donna warmly described Taylor's family as “very down to Earth” and said their connection “feels like home,” offering a glimpse into the growing bond between the two families beyond celebrity attention.

author: TNN
description: In Piplu Panchayat Samiti, nearly 50 road lights were removed after BJP candidate Priyanka Sharma lost the election by 751 votes. These lights were installed just before Diwali, which the villagers believed was a vote-winning tactic. Following the election results, villagers expressed anger at the lights being deemed illegal. Residents questioned the timing of the light removal after the results were announced.
title: BJP nominee loses Rajasthan poll, and village its streetlights

author: TANUJ LAKHINA
description: Aayan Khan’s $95,000 move to Dubai Capitals for ILT20 Season 5 is more than an auction milestone. The UAE all-rounder discusses learning from international stars, how franchise cricket has shaped his development, and why the league’s playing conditions offer crucial opportunities for UAE and Associate players to compete, improve and earn bigger opportunities.

author: JOY SENGUPTA
description: Autorickshaw unions in Pune have announced a one-day strike in response to illegal bike taxi operations. The strike, which will occur on Monday, is expected to disrupt daily commutes for many citizens. Protests will be held at various legislative offices to address these issues. Commuters fear overcharging and unavailability of transportation options during this time. The strike highlights ongoing tensions between autorickshaw drivers and bike taxi services in the city.
title: Auto unions in Pune to go on strike today against bike taxi operation

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), December gold futures shed Rs 14,927, or 11%, over the past week, settling at Rs 1,21,778 per 10 grams. The contract touched a low not seen in more than a year. Gold was last traded at a comparable level on October 30, 2025, when its price stood at Rs 1,21,508 per 10 grams
title: Gold falls to Rs 1.21 lakh, silver plunges 16.2%; analysts warn of further losses

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Pat Gelsinger emphasizes that merely enhancing traditional chip designs will fall short of fulfilling artificial intelligence's skyrocketing demands. He points out that there is an urgent need for major advancements in power management, cooling systems, and engineering to upgrade data centers effectively. While skepticism surrounding Moore's Law persists, Gelsinger remains hopeful for pioneering developments in semiconductor engineering.
title: Former Intel CEO on meeting AI chips demand: ‘Our greatest innovations are still ahead’

author: CHAITANYA MARPAKWAR
description: In a significant development for over 5,000 victims of the NSEL scam, a total of Rs 1,950 crore is set to be disbursed as a one-time settlement facilitated by the state government. This payout, which aims to help investors recoup their losses from the fraudulent scheme, will be managed by Justice (retd) S C Gupte, with funds sourced from previously liquidated assets.
title: 1,950cr one-time settlement for 5,600 victims of NSEL scam today

description: Parthiban Krishnamoorthi's journey to becoming a chartered accountant was fraught with challenges. After failing the CA Intermediate exams twice, he relocated to Bengaluru, where he juggled night shifts packaging orders and cycling for deliveries to make ends meet. His determination paid off as he ultimately passed his exams and joined BDO as an Article Assistant, embodying the spirit of resilience in the face of adversity.

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: Sanitation workers in India have a life expectancy of only 63.8 years, which is considerably lower. Urban male sanitation workers have even shorter life expectancies compared to female counterparts in the same field. The study revealed that occupational hazards greatly contribute to the risks faced by these workers. Financial burdens due to healthcare access are notably high among sanitation workers.
title: ‘Sanitation workers live 11 years less than professionals’

author: TNN
description: Sachin Verma was shot and killed while observing an argument at a roadside eatery in Bhaukhedi village. Villagers and relatives expressed their anger over his death and blocked a main road for several hours. They demanded immediate arrests and a fair investigation into the shooting incident. Police have formed a special investigation team to look into the matter and collect evidence.
title: Man stops to watch roadside fight, gets shot

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Chiefs heiress Gracie Hunt took her charitable efforts beyond America, supporting underprivileged children in South Africa and Brazil. Through soccer clinics and efforts to provide sporting equipment, she helped young people experience the benefits of sports. Her work reflected a belief that athletics could build confidence, create connections and open doors for children with limited opportunities, long before she became widely recognised through her family's NFL legacy.
title: Chiefs heiress Gracie Hunt takes charity mission to South Africa and Brazil

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Tanjot Singh from Delhi Public School developed an innovative air filtration system using compressed wool felt and electrostatic cotton. His project aimed to provide a sustainable alternative to synthetic HEPA filters commonly used for air purification. Tanjot initiated this project under the INSPIRE-MANAK programme, gaining recognition for its environmental benefits. He received mentorship at IIT Delhi to refine his research and prototype development.
title: Delhi's Tanjot Singh wins INSPIRE award for wool-and-cotton HEPA alternative

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Carol Esteban, owner of a glamping site, is grappling with a hefty £135,000 legal bill stemming from a contentious boundary dispute with neighbors Neil and Nadine Gould. The court has granted the Goulds a right of way to their parking area, dismissing Esteban's claims. Currently, her legal team is appealing this decision, as the ruling's implications may significantly impact both the right of way and her financial obligations.
title: Welsh glamping owner loses driveway row over missing map letter; £135k bill

author: SANJIB CHAKRABORTY

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: A suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack targeted a Russian warship at the Benghazi port, causing significant damage. Reports indicate that two drones successfully struck the corvette Merkury while it was docked to refuel. Libyan officials confirmed the incident and conducted an investigation into the attack's origin. Additionally, another drone attack occurred on a Malta-flagged commercial vessel off the coast.
title: Watch: Russian warship bursts into flames amid suspected Ukraine drone attack in Libya
